name: Mask - Beyond Lies
source:
Mask - Beyond Lies is an Otome visual novel set in a fantasy world. As you're transported to another world, a masked person guides you through the day to bring you back to your world. But is it really that simple?

Discover the stories behind each of the available love interests, their secrets and much more. With each choice, you'll discover the darkest secrets of their world. Are you willing to do anything to get back to your world? And will you be able to return home?

[translated from [url=https://kakera-art.itch.io/french-onlymaskbeyondlies]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Mask - Beyond Lies》是一部以奇幻世界为背景的乙女视觉小说。你被传送到异世界后，一位戴面具的人引导你度过这一天，试图将你送回原本的世界。可事情真的这么简单吗？

探索各位可攻略角色背后的故事、他们的秘密，以及更多未知。每一次选择，都会让你发现这个世界最黑暗的秘密。为了回去，你愿意不惜一切吗？你又能否回到家中？

[译自[url=https://kakera-art.itch.io/french-onlymaskbeyondlies]itch.io[/url]]
